Native canvases are cell multiples or the specified prop/receiver sizes; the failures are visual/structural rather than soft-alpha export errors. Final 2x and all three 3x crops exactly reproduce the current final, and squint equals its greyscale conversion. The ten block assemblers independently reconstruct their master bitmaps byte-for-byte; changing lot facing and floor counts leaves their pixels unchanged. These facts invalidate the inference that pixel ownership alone proves real perimeter buildings. No C7 seasonal partners were created: 923 seasonal @ files checked against the saved baseline are byte-identical, so a new summer/seasonal silhouette overlay test is not applicable; no seasonal silhouette failure is alleged.
